schema_note: v4.3 承诺阈值 — 应对评审'每个场景同时提供五种交互模式'过度概括。为每项指标分配阈值、有效条件、违约处置；阈值分为 commitment_effective_on_measurement（实测后生效）与 design_constraint_effective_at_pilot_launch（试点启动即生效的设计约束）两类语义。无证据之前所有指标保持 pending_baseline。

thresholds.effective_condition_zh: 首次季度实测发布后生效
thresholds.effective_condition_en: Effective after first quarterly field measurement is published
thresholds.disposition_on_breach_zh: 未达标节点进入整改台账并于下一季度复测；同一节点连续两季度未达标，则该节点场景降级为黄色受控状态
thresholds.disposition_on_breach_en: Non-compliant nodes enter rectification ledger and are re-measured next quarter; a node failing two consecutive quarters downgrades its scenario to the yellow controlled state

thresholds.name_zh: 非数字化等价路径可达率
thresholds.effective_condition_zh: 试点启动即生效（设计约束，非实测指标）
thresholds.effective_condition_en: Effective at pilot launch as design constraint, not measured indicator
thresholds.disposition_on_breach_zh: 任一 AI 服务点缺失等价路径，即暂停该点 AI 服务（与可证伪条件 2、失败模式 F3 同源）
thresholds.disposition_on_breach_en: Any AI service point lacking equivalent path has its AI service suspended (same origin as falsifiable condition 2 and failure mode F3)

thresholds.threshold_zh: 紧急类首响≤4小时；普通类首响≤24小时；咨询类首响≤48小时
thresholds.threshold_en: First response within 4 hours for urgent, 24 hours for routine, 48 hours for enquiries
thresholds.effective_condition_zh: 首次月度实测发布后生效
thresholds.effective_condition_en: Effective after first monthly field measurement is published
thresholds.disposition_on_breach_zh: 连续两季度劣化触发失败模式 F7，运行监督环节限期整改并公开
thresholds.disposition_on_breach_en: Worsening for two consecutive quarters triggers failure mode F7; the supervision link imposes a deadline for published rectification

thresholds.effective_condition_zh: 试点运行 6 个月后首次实测发布生效
thresholds.effective_condition_en: Effective after first 6-month pilot field measurement
thresholds.disposition_on_breach_zh: 低于阈值时回退至人工窗口默认开启并公开原因；纳入下一期治理委员会复审
thresholds.disposition_on_breach_en: If below threshold, default to fully manual window with public explanation; enters next governance committee review

thresholds.name_zh: 现场无障碍第三方审计达标率
thresholds.effective_condition_zh: 试点启动前由第三方完成审计；不通过即不可启动
thresholds.effective_condition_en: Third-party audit completed before pilot launch; non-pass means launch blocked
thresholds.disposition_on_breach_zh: 审计不通过则推迟启动并整改；连续两次不通过则降级场景为概念占位
thresholds.disposition_on_breach_en: If audit fails, postpone launch and rectify; two consecutive failures downgrade scenario to conceptual placeholder

thresholds.threshold_zh: ≥80% 的场景卡覆盖五模式（视觉/语音/触觉/手势/无障碍）
thresholds.threshold_en: ≥80% of scenario cards cover the 5 modes (visual/voice/tactile/gesture/accessibility)
thresholds.effective_condition_zh: 首次半年实测发布后生效
thresholds.effective_condition_en: Effective after first half-year measurement is published
thresholds.disposition_on_breach_zh: 未覆盖场景卡进入降级清单并公示降级理由；保留不适用项的替代路径
thresholds.disposition_on_breach_en: Non-covered scenario cards enter downgrade list with public reason; alternative paths retained for not-applicable items

evidence_status_zh: 所有阈值当前为承诺值（commitment value），不主张当前已达成；实测后进入 effective 状态
evidence_status_en: All thresholds are commitment values; current attainment is not claimed; effective status begins upon measurement
